text:
Sara: Heads-up — hotfix PR #8951 needs 2x LGTM before the 30m cutoff. CI is green but we need approvals for the cherry-pick and the rollback test. @Lee @Carter can you take a quick look?

deploy-bot: CI: all checks passed on PR #8951 (build, smoke, integration). merge blocker: approvals (2 required).

Mike: on it, I can eyeball the rollback path in 10.

Lee: will review now, focusing on the db migration shim and kv-cache tweak.

Anita: quick note — I saw one flaky assertion in smoke that might be unrelated, can you share the failing log snippet if it recurs?

Sara: not failing now, that was from yesterday's run. The only outstanding items are two human approvals. Cutoff t-minus 30.

Carter: skimmed diff, looks fine. running local smoke:
```
./scripts/run_smoke --pr 8951 --env staging
```
All good locally, LGTM from me :thumbsup:

Lee: found one docstring nit in router_config.go, filed a 1-line commit to the PR (pushed). After that, LGTM from me as well :eyes:

Sara: thanks both. Since we have 2x LGTM and CI green, I'll queue the merge and trigger the cutover. Anyone want to hold off?

Mike: nope, go ahead.

deploy-bot: merge-queue: PR #8951 enqueued for merge at next window. Post-merge: run db-rollforward-smoke.

Sara: merging now — will monitor logs and ping on incidents if anything odd. Thanks team :rocket:

Carter: nice work.

Anita: thx y'all — quick follow-up: add a tiny test in next patch for the edge case I mentioned. Not blocking this merge.

Sara: filed a follow-up issue (#452) and added it to next sprint. Closing loop.
